scientific_integrity: Proof derives every all-extension count by finite-field character sums and a prime-to-five Jacobian factorization; no outside independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordered marked coefficients over finite fields of characteristic five, not isomorphism classes, twists or singular boundary curves. Exhaustive finite-field checks through degree three support but do not prove the universal formulas. Earlier specialized superspecial enumeration may overlap the rank-zero component.
title: Exact parity-dependent p-rank strata of characteristic-five Ciani quartics
